kjv.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

bsb.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,

web.text: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

leads.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

flow.say: Henry shows how Christ was equipped, appointed, and sent to do three kinds of work: preaching good news, healing broken hearts, and freeing captives from sin.
The Spirit rested on Christ without measure, fitting him perfectly for his prophetical office.
God anointed him and sent him with full authority, just as he set apart kings and priests of old.
Christ preached good tidings to the meek and humble, those most ready to receive the gospel.
He binds up broken hearts, bringing ease and comfort to those humbled by guilt and sorrow.

morning.say: Carry with you today the truth that Christ's Spirit makes you free indeed from sin's captivity.
morning.phrase: The Son is ready by his Spirit to make us free
